subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Industrial Symbiosis
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Industrial Symbiosis.

hook.text: A power plant's waste heat warms a fish farm next door. The fish farm's waste feeds a nearby greenhouse.

buildup.text: Industrial symbiosis connects companies so one's waste becomes another's input—mimicking natural ecosystems.

discovery.text: It reduces waste, saves resources, and creates new revenue streams from materials that would be discarded.

twist.text: It requires geographic proximity and trust between companies. Competitive secrecy often blocks collaboration.

climax.text: Kalundborg, Denmark, has run an industrial symbiosis network since the 1970s—saving millions and cutting waste.

punchline.text: One company's waste is another's resource. Connect them.

quiz.question: What is industrial symbiosis?
options: One company's waste becoming another's input
